audioNote.markdown:
Welcome to Sessionboard!
In this quick video, we’ll walk you through how to create and assign a File Request task to a portal. File Request tasks are a great way to collect files from your event contacts.

Please note that this task type supports only one file upload, though contacts can upload updated versions if changes are needed. If you need to collect multiple files, consider creating a separate File Request task for each file or using a portal form instead.

steps.title: Title

audioNote.markdown:
There are three types of file requests you can create:

First, "People". Collect files from individual contacts, such as speaker agreements from accepted speakers.

Second, "Groups". Collect files from sponsor or exhibitor groups, like an ad for a program book.

Third, "Sessions". Collect a file per session, such as presentation materials.
